{{Top|leg}}
'''Zilbra fungus''' was a species of phosphorescent [[Fungus/Legends|fungus]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Thanta Zilbra (planet)|Thanta Zilbra]]. It increased the cell proliferation in animals, allowing it to be used to treat wounds in a similar manner to [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]].<ref name="CTD">''[[Cracken's Threat Dossier]]''</ref>
